14 | Mold Solid | 1 cu' | P | touch | F
15 | Make Staff | self | 24 hrs | self | F
16 | Break Solid | 1 cu' | P | 100'' | F
17 | Work Magic Cloth | self | 24 hrs | self | F
18 | Work Magic Leather | self | 24 hrs | self | F
19 | Work Magic Wood | self | 24 hrs | self | F
20 | Work Magic Organic True | self | 24 hrs | self | F
25 | Unstone | 100' cu | P | 100' | F
30 | Unmetal | 1 cu'' | P | 100' | F
50 | Transmutation | 1 oz. | P | touch | F

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to flawlessly fabricate and fashion non-magical cloth. All
required tools and materials must be present. The time to work the material is
halved.
@@ 2
Allows caster to flawlessly create non-magical leather (from animal skins).
All required tools and materials must be present. The time to work the
material is halved.
@@ 3
Allows caster to flawlessly work non-magical wood. All required tools and
materials must be present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 4
Allows caster to raise the temperature of 1 cubic foot of any solid, inanimate
material up to 500º F at a rate of 50 degrees per round of concentration.
Alternately, caster may chill the material down to 0º F at a rate of 50º per
round of concentration. Raising or lowering the temperature of additional
material (up to a maximum of 1 cubic foot per level) is accomplished at the
same rate.
@@ 5
Allows caster to work any non-magical organic material (e.g., horn, bone,
chitin, wax, feathers, hair, etc.). All required tools and materials must be
present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 6
Any previous cracks of flaws in material up to a 10' x 10' x 10' section will
extend to their limit.
@@ 7
Allows caster to make a “wand” which may be imbedded in it using Essence,
Mentalism, Channeling, or Arcane.
@@ 9
Causes any non-magical wood to ignite and burn. All wood ignited must be
within 1' of caster’s palm.
@@ 10
Allows caster to make a “rod” which may be imbedded in it using Essence,
Mentalism, Channeling, or Arcane.
@@ 11
Will turn 100 cubic feet of stone to packed earth, or 100 cubic feet of earth
to mud, or 100 cubic feet of mud to earth, or 100 cubic feet of earth to
stone.
@@ 12
Causes a non-metal, inanimate object to shatter (up to 1 cubic foot in size).
All within 5'R take an ‘A’ Impact critical (anyone holding the object takes a
‘C’). Metal objects get a +30 RR modification.
@@ 14
By molding with his hands, caster may shape 1 cubic foot of solid, inanimate
material as if it were putty or clay. At the end of the spell’s duration, the
stone will harden to normal consistency.
@@ 15
Allows caster to make a “staff” which may be imbedded in it using Essence,
Mentalism, Channeling, or Arcane.
@@ 16
1 cubic foot of any solid, inanimate material becomes very brittle. This
causes the object to break if struck (the GM may rule that certain objects get
an RR to resist breakage).
@@ 17
Allows caster to flawlessly fabricate and fashion magical cloth. All required
tools and materials must be present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 18
Allows caster to flawlessly create magical leather (from animal skins). All
required tools and materials must be present. The time to work the material is
halved.
@@ 19
Allows caster to flawlessly work magical wood. All required tools and
materials must be present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 20
Allows caster to work any magical organic material (e.g., horn, bone, chitin,
wax, feathers, hair, etc.). All required tools and materials must be present.
The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 25
Disintegrates (i.e., nothing is left of ) the target 100 cubic feet of stone.
@@ 30
As Unstone, except affects 1 cubic foot of metal.
@@ 50
May transmute 1 oz. of any solid material into another non-magical solid
material that the caster has a sample of. This spell takes 8 hours of
continuous, uninterrupted concentration.
